traps.title: GraphQL interface vs Apollo fragment type
traps.trick: Same 8 fields (incl. nested lines[] and shippingAddress{}) declared as a server-side interface and a client-side type literal, different order and name; no GraphQL normalizer, plain TS.

traps.title: MobX observable class vs plain interface
traps.trick: SessionStore (makeObservable/observable) and SessionRecord interface share 8 identical properties; the framework wrapper must not hide the shape match.

traps.title: Redux slice state vs Zustand store shape
traps.trick: CartState (redux) and CartStore (zustand) declare the same 6 fields in different order; the createSlice/create call objects are not entities, only the named types are.

traps.title: Zod schema vs plain interface
traps.trick: PaymentSchema (z.object) and Payment interface describe the same 8 fields incl. enum/nullable/optional; zod normalizer must reduce the schema to the same property set.

traps.title: Bare type alias (reuse, not copy)
traps.trick: type Account = AccountBase is a pure rename -> alias verdict, NOT duplicate. Bonus reuse check in same folder: PremiumAccount extends AccountBase must be none/alias, not duplicate.

traps.title: Unannotated object duplicates a type without implements
traps.trick: defaultDeliveryTarget is an UNANNOTATED const whose shape+values mirror the NotificationEndpoint interface; no annotation/implements, so both are separate entities describing one thing.

traps.title: Renamed copy: all keys different, deep values identical
traps.trick: releaseGate vs rolloutPolicy: every key renamed at every level, but the deep value tree (>=3 levels, arrays, mixed primitives) is byte-identical -> renamed-copy duplicate.

traps.title: Partial value overlap must veto duplicate
traps.trick: digestSettings vs alertPreferences: same structure, all keys renamed, exactly 6 of 12 leaf values differ -> values veto, similar not duplicate.

traps.title: Method names one letter apart
traps.trick: TicketService vs TicketFacade: 8 methods each differing by a single mid-name letter (fetchTicket/fetchTirket); property names match but values differ, isolating the near-miss method signal -> similar.

traps.title: Long shared method prefix
traps.trick: InternalCustomerRepository vs CustomerRepository: identical 6-method set modulo the 'internalRepository' prefix on every name; no properties. Judgment call: similar (duplicate if prefixes stripped, none if exact-name matching).

traps.title: Enum vs string-literal union, same closed set
traps.trick: ShipmentStatus enum and ShipmentState union hold the same 8 string members in different order -> values duplicate.

traps.title: Enum vs union with one extra member
traps.trick: InvoiceStatus (6 members) vs BillingState (same 6 + 'disputed'); near-miss closed sets must not collapse to duplicate -> similar/extract.

traps.title: Interface vs implementing class with extra private machinery
traps.trick: Interface vs class that IMPLEMENTS it + extra private machinery. Implements is reuse (inheritance), not duplication — the engine must NOT call it a duplicate (drop-inheritance).

traps.title: Same property names, every type different (negative)
traps.trick: SensorSample vs SensorCalibration: identical 8 property names but every type genuinely differs (string/number/boolean/array/object swapped) -> none, not duplicate.

traps.title: MST model vs MobX class, same domain shape
traps.trick: WarehouseModel (mobx-state-tree types.model) and WarehouseStore (mobx class) share 7 fields incl. maybe/undefined; two recognized frameworks, one shape -> duplicate.

traps.title: Keystone list config vs class-validator DTO
traps.trick: ProductListing (keystone list fields) and ProductDto (class-validator decorated class) describe the same 6 product fields; both frameworks recognized -> duplicate.

traps.title: Intersection extension is reuse, not copy (negative)
traps.trick: type AuditedWebhookEvent = WebhookEvent & {extra} builds ON TOP of the base; inheritance/reuse -> none, not duplicate (not a bare alias either).

traps.title: Getters vs readonly properties (invention)
traps.trick: FeatureFlagState exposes the same 8 flags as FeatureFlagView through getters over a private snapshot instead of readonly stored properties; tests accessor-vs-property normalization. High variance: similar (none if getters count as methods, duplicate if normalized to properties).
